name: code-walkthrough
description: Create a self-contained interactive HTML explainer of code for a reader with no prior knowledge: a change (branch, PR, diff) or how existing code works (subsystem, feature, flow), with before/after toggles, mermaid diagrams, step-through code walkers, and playground widgets. Use when the user asks for an explainer HTML file or page, a walkthrough or teaching document of a branch or PR, before/after visuals, or to learn a codebase area from zero.
